Dataroma's MSFT page shows roughly 19 distinct managers increasing stakes, broad-based across value and quality-growth shops, even as several large funds (TCI, Polen, Tiger Global, Appaloosa, Oakmark, Fundsmith) TRIMMED. Counts verified; per-row share-change and value figures in the original input were largely fabricated and have been corrected to Dataroma totals/percent changes where verifiable. Note ValueAct, Tiger Global, Egerton, Davis, Dodge & Cox and Viking REDUCED Amazon and were not eligible as 'Added' rows. Original per-row share/value figures were inaccurate and corrected to Dataroma totals/percent changes; uniform buyPrice $208.27 was fabricated and removed.

Added.context: Alphabet was added to by ~8 super investors across both share classes in Q1 2026, headlined by Berkshire Hathaway more than tripling its Class A stake (~204-225%, from ~17.85M to ~58M sh, $15.6B) in the first 13F under new CEO Greg Abel. TCI, H&H, Egerton and Baupost boosted Class C (GOOG). Berkshire's GOOGL change of ~36-40M shares and $15.6B value verified against Dataroma and press; Egerton/H&H/TCI/Baupost GOOG position values match Dataroma exactly. Reduced.name: Alphabet Inc. (Class A / Class C)
Reduced.context: VERIFIED against Dataroma activity page (sym=GOOGL): 23 'Reduce' rows plus Pershing Square at -95.23%, totaling 24 distinct managers trimming (not fully exiting) GOOGL in Q1 2026 — the most-trimmed name among tracked super investors. All 8 share figures below match Dataroma exactly; qtr-end reference (hold) price of $287.56 confirmed. Caveat: Pershing Square (Ackman) cut ~95% (-645.9K shares), a near-total liquidation that Dataroma still classifies as 'Reduce' rather than a full exit — retained but flagged. Reduced.name: Microsoft Corp.

Chris Hohn's TCI was the standout, cutting ~84% (~14.1M shares, ~$8B), citing AI uncertainty around Office — corroborated by Hedgeweek and Seeking Alpha. Reduced.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (ADR)

Reduced.name: Visa Inc.

A cluster of quality-compounder managers (Akre -38.77%, Polen -27.54%, Valley Forge -34.66%, Fundsmith -12.18%) taking profits. Confirmed: Buffett's Berkshire (8.30M shares) and Glenn Greenberg's Brave Warrior FULLY EXITED Visa and are correctly excluded from this trim count.

Reduced.name: Capital One Financial Corp.
Reduced.context: VERIFIED against Dataroma activity page (sym=COF): 12 'Reduce' rows in Q1 2026. All 8 figures below match exactly; $182.43 qtr-end reference price confirmed. Partly profit-taking after the Discover deal closed and the stock re-rated; Viking (-1.34M, -45.39%) and Loeb's Third Point (-960K, -87.27%) made the largest cuts. Exited.name: Microsoft Corp.
Exited.context: Three large managers fully exited Microsoft in Q1 2026 even as it remained a consensus AI winner. The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust sold its final ~7.7M shares (~$3.2B) as part of a long-planned, performance-agnostic endowment wind-down; Stephen Mandel's Lone Pine Capital exited along with other mega-cap tech (Amazon, Broadcom) to rotate toward AI-infrastructure/energy names; and John Armitage's Egerton Capital sold out Microsoft entirely (it had been Egerton's largest holding just two quarters earlier). All three exits verified via Q1 2026 13F coverage. (TCI/Chris Hohn sharply cut but did not fully exit, so is excluded.)

Exited.name: Veeva Systems Inc.
Exited.context: Veeva was exited by two growth managers in Q1 2026 amid a broad retreat from traditional SaaS multiples and AI-disruption fears. Chase Coleman's Tiger Global sold its entire stake (Veeva appears among Tiger's seven Q1 full sold-out positions), and Henry Ellenbogen's Durable Capital Partners likewise closed out Veeva (one of Durable's 11 full exits this quarter, after trimming ~$213M the prior quarter). Both full exits verified via Q1 2026 13F coverage; the ~2.42M-share/~$540M figure for Tiger is widely cited but the exact exit metrics are not disclosed in the summary filings, so it is shown as approximate.

Exited.name: UnitedHealth Group Inc.
Exited.context: UnitedHealth was the most notable single full exit of Q1 2026: Greg Abel's first Berkshire 13F dumped the entire ~5.0M-share stake (~$1.66B, first disclosed Aug 2025) after the stock rebounded ~45% off its lows, amid the insurer's operational and regulatory turmoil. Note: the prior data also attributed UNH exits to Scion (Michael Burry) and Torray, but both were removed — Scion held no UNH entering Q1 2026 (its Q3 2025 book was only Molina/Lululemon/SLM/Bruker), and Torray was in fact ADDING to UNH in early 2026 and still held ~$19.5M (a ~2.7% position), the opposite of an exit.

Exited.name: Intuit Inc.
Exited.context: Intuit was fully exited by two quality-focused managers in Q1 2026, with selling tied in part to fears that generative AI could disrupt TurboTax/QuickBooks. Terry Smith's Fundsmith closed its position entirely (alongside exits of Nike, Graco, Oddity Tech), and Nicolai Tangen's former shop AKO Capital also fully exited Intuit. Both confirmed. The earlier Torray Funds attribution was removed — Intuit is not a Torray holding and the row could not be verified.

Exited.name: Flutter Entertainment Plc
Exited.context: Flutter was fully liquidated by Chase Coleman's Tiger Global in Q1 2026 (Flutter appears among Tiger's seven full Q1 sold-out positions; the ~4.0M-share/~$861M figure is widely cited though exact exit metrics are not disclosed in summary filings). The earlier Makaira Partners attribution was removed — Makaira only REDUCED Flutter by ~46.4% in Q1 2026 and still held the position, so it does not qualify as an exit.

trump.name: Donald J. Trump
trump.subtitle: 45th & 47th President · through Q2 2026 filings
trump.blurb: First sitting president in roughly six decades to disclose active individual-securities trading. 2026 so far: 6,236 disclosed transactions across two OGE Form 278-T filings — Q1’s 3,711 (filed 8 May) plus Q2’s 2,525 covering 7 Apr–29 May (filed 25 Jun, again past the 45-day STOCK Act deadline, late fees paid). His first annual disclosure (927-page Form 278e, released by OGE 30 Jun) shows 21,000+ securities trades in year one back in office (~85 per market day) and >$1.4B of 2025 crypto income. Figures use midpoints of disclosed bands from named outlets. Not financial advice.

policyMoves.title: WLFI 62B-token unlock approved; American Bitcoin treasury tops 8,000 BTC
bullets: Apr 30, 2026: WLFI governance vote (~99.5% in favor, later reported ~99.9%) approved restructuring the 62B-token unlock — insiders incl. the Trump family: 40.7B tokens on a 2-year cliff + 5-year vesting, ~4.5B tokens (10% of holdings) burned.
Jul 6, 2026: American Bitcoin (ABTC, Hut 8 majority-owned, Eric Trump co-founder) passed 8,000 BTC (+~50% in six months; 817 mined + 1,620 bought in Q1) despite an $81.8M Q1 net loss.
Context from the annual 278e: 2025 crypto income >$1.4B — WLF token sales >$550M, memecoin royalties >$635M, WLF interest sales $260M, stablecoin holdco equity >$196M — crypto out-earned real estate.

policyMoves.title: DJT pivots to fusion energy (TAE merger) and monetizes his market-moving posts (Truth API)
bullets: Jun 10, 2026: DJT and TAE Technologies confirmed their merger remains on track to close Q4 2026 or earlier; the Truth Social spin-off (via Texas Ventures Acquisition III) was dropped, with "strategic alternatives" to be evaluated for legacy media assets.

Jul 20, 2026: DJT unveiled Truth API — paid B2B real-time access to posts from top Truth Social accounts, launching 1 Aug ("Markets already move on Truth Social posts" — interim CEO Kevin McGurn). DJT +13.1% on the week; hedge-fund holders fell from 21 to 17 in Q1.

policyMoves.title: U.S. equity stake in Intel + AI chip licensing reversal
bullets: Aug 22, 2025: U.S. government took a 9.9% stake in Intel for $8.9B (CHIPS Act + DoD Secure Enclave funds converted to equity).
Jan 13, 2026: Commerce Dept's BIS revised NVIDIA H200 and AMD MI325X export licensing from "presumption of denial" to "case-by-case review."

Trump's figures are inherently lagged: trades surface via 278-T reports up to 45 days after execution (and his have been filed late), the full annual disclosure comes once a year, and net-worth estimates come from valuation houses. A daily refresh re-checks for new filings — it does not make the last filing newer. Next scheduled catalyst: Q2-2026 13F season, 14 Aug 2026.

superInvestors.definition:
We currently track {count} super investors — funds and managers who run concentrated portfolios where individual trades reflect genuine conviction.

Many large institutions hold thousands of positions across passive index funds and broad mandates, making their individual trades largely meaningless as investment signals. We focus on investors whose buys and sells actually carry informational value.

This list is continuously reviewed and expanded over time as we identify additional funds that meet our criteria.
